title: Multi-branch gateway bus v3
description: Adds immutable bootstrap main, rolling gateway control branches, append-only project branches, per-project workers, and guarded rceman/typer migration.

requirements.summary: Use immutable bootstrap main and branch-per-gateway/project
acceptance: AC-001: main is locally pinned and receives no runtime commits.
AC-002: control and project branch patterns derive from gateway and project identity.
AC-003: unsupported or changed bootstrap templates fail readiness.

requirements.summary: Publish one-file rolling gateway control snapshots
acceptance: AC-004: gateway/<gateway_id> contains only gateway.json.
AC-005: snapshots have main as parent and use exact force-with-lease.
AC-006: startup, heartbeat, status changes, and shutdown publish bounded liveness data without secrets.
AC-007: every project branch has project identity, context, checkpoint, inbox, results, and archive.
AC-008: divergent project identity fails instead of being overwritten.
AC-009: project branches never force-push.

requirements.summary: Isolate task routing and per-project queues
acceptance: AC-010: tasks use branch-local inbox/<task_id>.taskbundle.json paths.
AC-011: config, branch, project.json, envelope, and manifest identity must agree.
AC-012: one project worker is serial while separate projects may execute concurrently.

requirements.summary: Publish final result and checkpoint atomically
acceptance: AC-013: result and checkpoint are one append-only project commit.
AC-014: non-fast-forward conflicts are retried from current remote HEAD.
AC-015: completed tasks are not redispatched.
AC-016: legacy bus.branch configs fail with deterministic migration guidance.
AC-017: branch patterns are strictly validated and only approved variables expand.
AC-018: resume IDs, paths, launch arguments, and execution policy remain local-only.
AC-019: migration defaults to dry-run and requires exact repository confirmation.
AC-020: all refs, config, binary, and local bus state are backed up before mutation.
AC-021: legacy refs are deleted only after new main, control, projects, readiness, and branch trees verify.

requirements.summary: Register the three initial home_pc projects
acceptance: AC-022: gpt-github-gateway, gpt-review-planner, and airelay project branches are created.
AC-023: airelay uses therceman/airelay with default branch master.
AC-024: missing Airelay session binding is reported as configuration_required rather than claimed ready.
AC-025: task bundle and result payloads remain protocol-v2 compatible.
AC-026: no third-party Go or Python dependency is introduced.
AC-027: gateway.json excludes local paths, resume IDs, launch arguments, credentials, and private logs.

requirements.summary: Advance gateway release and operator documentation
acceptance: AC-028: VERSION and CLI report 0.3.0.
AC-029: docs and examples describe only the multi-branch contract.
AC-030: startup detects a process that exits immediately instead of reporting success.

gates.name: Disposable complete migration
gates.command: Run the documented complete migration against a disposable local bare bus fixture and verify the final branch allowlist.

gates.name: Backed-up rceman/typer migration
gates.command: Execute scripts/migrate-bus-multibranch.py only after all source gates and feature-branch push pass.

gates.name: Installed gateway runtime
gates.command: Verify version 0.3.0, running status, doctor, readiness, control lease, and all three project branches.

gpt_static_checks_performed: Reconstructed the exact 0.2.0 source from previously validated patch packs and included the agent fixture repair present in main.
Authored complete schema-v2 configuration, multi-branch bus manager, per-project workers, control snapshots, project bootstrap, migration utility, tests, schemas, and documentation.
Ran Go formatting, vet, tests, and build in a disposable Go 1.23 compatibility copy; these are advisory sandbox checks, not the required host Go 1.24 gates.
Ran Python unit tests, compileall, shell syntax, JSON parsing, Git whitespace, branch bootstrap, rolling snapshot, independent gateway, and immutable-template regression checks.
Built a full-file overlay and verified that it contains only the declared created and modified paths.
gpt_runtime_checks_not_performed: Host Go 1.24 acceptance gates in the owner environment.
Real Git bundle backup and legacy ref deletion.
Installation and execution of gateway 0.3.0 on home_pc.
Live heartbeat, readiness, Airelay sessions, and project branch verification.
Real protocol-v2 task dispatch after migration.
known_integration_risks: The real migration force-updates rceman/typer main and deletes legacy refs; it is permitted only after verified backup and every implementation gate passes.
The current planner pin remains v1.2.0 until the separate planner release is integrated; AGENT_PROMPT.md is included only for validator compatibility.
Airelay may be registered as configuration_required if no verified airelay_master resume binding exists.
The agent must use the host Go 1.24 toolchain declared by go.mod.
forbidden_deviations: Do not migrate rceman/typer before source gates, commits, evidence, and feature-branch push pass.
Do not put runtime state in main or more than gateway.json in a control branch.
Do not force-push project branches or use blind force for control/main updates.
Do not modify gpt-review-planner or therceman/airelay source in this task.
Do not invent Airelay resume IDs, weaken archive validation, add YAML transport, or add third-party dependencies.
